He is also a co-host of the popular film podcast How Did This Get Made? Mantzoukas likely crossed paths with Conan O'Brien as a comedy peer working in overlapping improv and television circles.

Reggie Watts.description: Reggie Watts is an American comedian, musician, and actor known for improvised performances built entirely from his voice, a keyboard, and a looping machine. He served as the regular house musician on the IFC spoof talk show Comedy Bang! Bang! and led the house band for The Late Late Show with James Corden from 2015 to 2023. His comedy specials include Why Shit So Crazy?, A Live at Central Park, and Transition, the last of which earned him a MAP Fund Award and a Creative Capital Award. A comedy peer of Conan O'Brien, Watts appeared on O'Brien's Legally Prohibited from Being Funny on Television Tour, marking an early connection between the two.

Aaron Eckhart.description: Aaron Eckhart is an American actor who built his reputation through a string of critically noted film performances, beginning with Neil LaBute's dark comedy In the Company of Men (1997), which earned him an Independent Spirit Award for Best Debut Performance. He gained broader recognition as George in Erin Brockovich (2000) and received a Golden Globe nomination for Thank You for Smoking (2006). His role as Harvey Dent/Two-Face in Christopher Nolan's The Dark Knight (2008) brought him wide mainstream attention. His extensive filmography also includes Rabbit Hole, Olympus Has Fallen, Sully, and Midway. Eckhart likely first crossed paths with Conan O'Brien on Late Night with Conan O'Brien around 2008.

Michael Cera.description: Michael Cera is a Canadian actor and musician best known for his comedic leading roles in films such as Superbad, Juno, and Scott Pilgrim vs. the World, and for portraying George Michael Bluth in the acclaimed Fox sitcom Arrested Development. A BAFTA, Critics' Choice, SAG, and Tony Award nominee, he has built a varied career spanning film, television, voice work, and Broadway, with recent credits including Barbie, Dream Scenario, Scott Pilgrim Takes Off, and Sausage Party: Foodtopia. He also released a debut album and has toured as bassist for indie rock supergroup Mister Heavenly. He likely crossed paths with Conan O'Brien on Late Night with Conan O'Brien around 2007, during the breakthrough period of his film career.
